questions.question_english: Identify the incorrect statement regarding the impact of ICT on parent-teacher interaction.
options_english: It allows working parents to monitor their child’s progress without physically visiting the school.
It facilitates rapid dissemination of emergency information, such as sudden school closures.
It guarantees that all parents will successfully interpret complex digital assessment rubrics.
It creates asynchronous channels for parents to submit queries and feedback.
questions.explanation_english: While information and communication technology provides convenient digital channels for monitoring student progress, receiving emergency notifications, and sending asynchronous inquiries, it cannot guarantee that every parent possesses equal digital literacy or conceptual understanding to interpret complex assessment rubrics. Effective parental engagement still requires structured teacher guidance, clear contextual communication, and inclusive offline support mechanisms.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: While information and communication technology provides convenient digital channels for monitoring student progress, receiving emergency notifications, and sending asynchronous inquiries, it cannot guarantee that every parent possesses equal digital literacy or conceptual understanding to interpret complex assessment rubrics.

questions.question_english:
Which of the following represents an exception to safe
      digital communication practices within a school
      environment?
options_english: Using BCC (Blind Carbon Copy) when sending mass emails to parents to protect privacy
Using official email addresses for all communication with higher authorities
Discussing sensitive student disciplinary matters on an open WhatsApp group
Archiving official digital correspondence according to retention rules
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option C, which states that discussing sensitive student disciplinary matters on an open WhatsApp group is an exception to safe digital communication practices. Discussing confidential student disciplinary cases in public or unencrypted instant messaging groups violates data privacy laws and administrative ethics. Safe digital communication protocols require maintaining strict confidentiality regarding sensitive student records. Official email systems, encrypted administrative channels, and official closed files must be utilized exclusively for formal disciplinary actions to protect student privacy and preserve organizational integrity.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। संवेदनशील छात्र अनुशासनात्मक मामलों पर एक खुले व्हाट्सएप समूह में चर्चा करना सुरक्षित डिजिटल संचार प्रथाओं का अपवाद है। सार्वजनिक या अनएन्क्रिप्टेड तात्कालिक संदेश समूहों में गोपनीय छात्र अनुशासनात्मक मामलों पर चर्चा करना डेटा गोपनीयता कानूनों और प्रशासनिक नैतिकता का उल्लंघन करता है। सुरक्षित डिजिटल संचार प्रोटोकॉल संवेदनशील छात्र रिकॉर्ड के संबंध में सख्त गोपनीयता बनाए रखने की आवश्यकता होती है। छात्र की गोपनीयता की रक्षा और संगठनात्मक अखंडता को बनाए रखने के लिए आधिकारिक ईमेल प्रणालियों, एन्क्रिप्टेड प्रशासनिक चैनलों और आधिकारिक बंद फ़ाइलों का उपयोग विशेष रूप से औपचारिक अनुशासनात्मक कार्यों के लिए किया जाना चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Discussing sensitive student disciplinary matters on an open WhatsApp group

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Discussing confidential student disciplinary cases on public or unencrypted instant messaging groups violates data privacy laws and administrative ethics.

questions.question_english:
A school administration is planning to migrate
     its local database to a cloud-based Software
     as a Service (SaaS) model. What is a primary
     financial benefit of this migration?
options_english: Structural shift converting flexible operational expenses into large permanent capital hardware investments
Elimination of upfront hardware capital costs and reduced maintenance expenses.
Full statutory exemption from paying applicable Goods and Services Tax (GST) on commercial broadband subscriptions
Financial authorization allowing schools to monetize and sell student database analytics to third-party advertisers
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'Elimination of upfront hardware capital costs and reduced maintenance expenses.' Migrating local databases to a cloud-based Software as a Service model delivers primary financial benefits by converting heavy upfront capital investments in physical server hardware into predictable operational expenditure. Institutions eliminate ongoing local server hardware maintenance, reduce cooling costs, and avoid specialized in-house IT infrastructure management expenses while gaining scalable storage and automated vendor security updates.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। इस स्थानांतरण का एक प्रमुख वित्तीय लाभ है प्रारंभिक हार्डवेयर पूंजी लागतों का उन्मूलन और रखरखाव खर्चों में कमी। स्थानीय डेटाबेस को क्लाउड-आधारित SaaS मॉडल में स्थानांतरित करने से भारी प्रारंभिक पूंजी निवेशों को पूर्वानुमानित परिचालन व्यय में परिवर्तित किया जा सकता है। संस्थान चल रहे स्थानीय सर्वर हार्डवेयर रखरखाव को समाप्त करते हैं, शीतलन लागतों को कम करते हैं, और विशेषीकृत इन-हाउस आईटी अवसंरचना प्रबंधन खर्चों से बचते हैं, जबकि स्केलेबल स्टोरेज और स्वचालित विक्रेता सुरक्षा अपडेट प्राप्त करते हैं।
